app.name: YK Station
onboard.install.title: Put YK Station on your Home Screen
onboard.install.lead: Notifications only work from the Home Screen, and it opens full screen like a normal app
onboard.install.step1: Tap Safari's Share button (bottom bar or next to the address)
onboard.install.step2: Scroll down, tap “Add to Home Screen”, then “Add”
onboard.install.step3: Open the pink bear “YK站” from your Home Screen and sign in once more
onboard.install.skip: Just look around in the browser
onboard.push.title: Turn on notifications
onboard.push.lead: So you know when the other one needs you
onboard.push.b1: Kyle asking you to drink, cups to review
onboard.push.b2: The bear falling ill and who has to pay
